## Supervisor v0.11.0

### Remind me later
- **Put a reminder off:** a research deadline whose reminder is up on the dashboard (a qualifying exam months away, say) has a **Later** button. Choose to be reminded in a week, two weeks or a few months, or a few weeks before the deadline.
- **Until then:** the item leaves *Needs attention*, and the reminder in the calendar moves to that day. Once the deadline has passed it is flagged as overdue as usual.
- **Going back:** the student's details show the reminder as *(put off)*, with **Usual reminder** to undo it.
- Works for every research deadline: the standard ones, those of external programmes and those added by hand.

### Names only
- **Calendar and invites:** event titles, invite files, Google Calendar links and exported calendars name the student without their B number.
- **Dashboard:** *Upcoming* and *Needs attention* show just the name.

### Hide names when opening
- Settings › Privacy has **Hide names when Supervisor opens**. Supervisor then starts in privacy mode, and again after each unlock, until **Show names** is clicked.

### External programmes
- What was "Brazilian programme" is now for any programme with its own stages: tick **Follow its stages, grant and defence** under *Their programme* in an external student's research details.
- The suggested deadlines are unchanged and still follow common practice in Brazil (CAPES, CNPq); change them in Settings › **External programmes** to suit other programmes. The Brazilian funders are still listed, under *Brazil*, with *Other* for anyone else.

### Placement students
- **Pending modules:** placement students now have the **Modules** card, as advisees and project students do.
- **Visit deadlines:** a placement module (Settings › Modules & coursework, *Placement* ticked) has, for Visit 1 and Visit 2, **To be done by** and **Mark entered by** dates.
- **Reminders:** the dashboard reminds you of a visit not booked from 4 weeks before it is to be done, of one booked too late, and of one not done in time. A visit mark not entered is reminded like other marks (Settings › Marking deadlines). The *to be done by* dates are in the calendar.
- **In the student's details:** each visit shows when it is to be done by, and *mark by* beside the mark.

### Extensions for students you mark
- **MSc dissertations and placement reports:** tick **Extension** in the student's Marking section and give the number of days. Your marking date moves on by as many.
- **Final-year projects:** a new **Deadlines** section lists the poster and dissertation deadlines, with an **Extension** date for each. Your marking date follows it.

### Poster list
- **Poster list (PDF)…** in Marking › Final-year projects saves a table of the posters you mark, in poster order: poster number, B number, student, supervisor and course. It fits on one landscape page, in large print, ready to take to the poster session.
- The PDF is not encrypted.

### Notes
- Existing data files open unchanged. Visit deadlines start unset and nothing is hidden at startup, so nothing changes until you set them.
